title: BoardGameGeek Play Log Play Minutes Leaderboard
dataSources: BoardGameGeek plays (`bgg:play`), Poker Now sessions (`pokernow:session`), Bridge Base Online boards (`bridgebase:board`), and Lichess tournament rounds (`lichess:tournament`).
app: BoardGameGeek play logs, Poker Now session exports, Bridge Base Online boards, and Lichess tournament data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bgg:play play_minutes=*
| stats sum(play_minutes) as total_value, avg(play_minutes) as avg_value by game_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks game name values by total and average play minutes across BoardGameGeek play log events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `play_minutes` values for each BoardGameGeek play log event and review total and average play minutes by game name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total play minutes.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which game name shows the biggest play minutes numbers in your BoardGameGeek play log data.
